def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Get build zone boundaries
    build_min_x, build_max_x, build_min_y, build_max_y = sandbox.get_build_zone()

    # Center of the build zone
    beam_x = (build_min_x + build_max_x) / 2
    beam_y = (build_min_y + build_max_y) / 2

    # Minimal beam dimensions to reduce mass
    beam_width = 0.1  # Minimum allowed width
    beam_height = 0.1  # Minimum allowed height

    # Calculate density to achieve mass within budget (0.02 kg)
    area = beam_width * beam_height
    density = 0.02 / area  # kg/m²

    # Add the beam
    beam = sandbox.add_beam(beam_x, beam_y, beam_width, beam_height, density=density)

    return beam


def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    # Define target y-position (center of build zone)
    build_min_x, build_max_x, build_min_y, build_max_y = sandbox.get_build_zone()
    target_y = (build_min_y + build_max_y) / 2  # 7.25 m

    # Current position and velocity
    pos = agent_body.position
    vel = agent_body.linearVelocity

    # Proportional control gain
    kp = 0.1
    # Damping control gain
    kd = 0.05

    # Compute error and damping force
    error_y = pos.y - target_y
    damping_y = -kd * vel.y

    # Apply force to correct position and damp motion
    force_y = -kp * error_y + damping_y

    # Apply the net force to the beam center
    agent_body.ApplyForceToCenter((0, force_y), wake=True)
